CFML Language Reference: Functions

Hour

Returns the hour part of a date/time value, on the 24-hour clock.

Category

Date and time functions

Syntax

Hour(date)

Parameters

date
A date/time value or a string that can be converted to one, including a bare time such as "2:30 PM".

Returns

A number from 0 to 23.

Usage

Same as DatePart("h", date). Midnight is 0 and 2:30 PM is 14.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFSET H = Hour(Now())>
<CFOUTPUT>
<P>Hour("2:30 PM") = #Hour("2:30 PM")#, Hour(CreateTime(0, 15, 0)) = #Hour(CreateTime(0, 15, 0))#</P>
<P>It is #H# o'clock at the server. Good
<CFIF H LT 12>morning<CFELSEIF H LT 18>afternoon<CFELSE>evening</CFIF>!</P>
</CFOUTPUT>

See also

Minute, Second, TimeFormat, DatePart
